title: Profile card
description:
Store the facts about a game character in variables, then print a profile card from them. Use these values:

| Variable | Type | Value |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `std::string` | "Aria" |
| `level` | `int` | 7 |
| `health` | `double` | 82.5 |
| `rank` | `char` | 'B' |
| `isAlive` | `bool` | true |

Expected output (a `bool` prints as `1` for true):

```
Name: Aria
Level: 7
Health: 82.5
Rank: B
Alive: 1
```
hints: You can chain text and variables in one statement: `std::cout << "Level: " << level << '\n';`
Text uses double quotes (`"Aria"`), a single character uses single quotes (`'B'`).
rules: Store the name in a `std::string` named `name`.
Store the alive flag in a `bool` named `isAlive`.
